title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
contract: Return the length of the longest substring without repeated ASCII characters.
reasoning: Restart a set at every start and stop when uniqueness fails.
The optimized window is always unique. A repeated character requires moving left beyond its previous occurrence.
Use max when moving left: an occurrence outside the current window must never move the boundary backward.
